import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_rstat_workspace structure
class GslRstatWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ('min', ctypes.c_double),
        ('max', ctypes.c_double),
        ('mean', ctypes.c_double),
        ('M2', ctypes.c_double),
        ('M3', ctypes.c_double),
        ('M4', ctypes.c_double),
        ('n', ctypes.c_size_t),
        ('median_workspace_p', ctypes.c_void_p)
    ]

# Define the function prototypes
# gsl_rstat_alloc returns a pointer to gsl_rstat_workspace
gsl.gsl_rstat_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GslRstatWorkspace)
# gsl_rstat_free takes a pointer to gsl_rstat_workspace
gsl.gsl_rstat_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GslRstatWorkspace)]

def allocate_and_free_workspace():
    try:
        # Allocate the workspace
        workspace = gsl.gsl_rstat_alloc()
        if not workspace:
            return False

        # Free the workspace
        gsl.gsl_rstat_free(workspace)
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        return False

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    assert allocate_and_free_workspace() == True, "Test case 1 failed"
    print("All test cases passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
